answer_1.quote: Large Language Model (LLM)-based tools such as have demonstrated an impressive ability to create high-quality code given simple prompts...
datasets: CS1 and CS2 assignments from University of Arizona

answer_2.quote: We create test oracles to check correctness scores of a given assignment solution... runs a predefined set of test cases and outputs the percentage of test cases passed by the solution.

answer_4.quote: We run a user study to understand the potential for such perturbation techniques in impeding actual LLM-assisted cheating... Our post-study survey also asks whether students noticed anything 'unusual' in the assignment description, how they validated solutions, etc.
answer_4.guideline: Survey questions include detection of unusual assignment descriptions, validation techniques for solutions, and methods to neutralize perturbations.
